description.value: Cona Vacation Getaways is a small family-run vacation rental management company based in the Comox Valley, named after nearby Strathcona Provincial Park. Founded in 2008 as a backpacker's hostel in downtown Courtenay, it has grown to manage a portfolio of ski chalets and lodges concentrated around Mt. Washington. The owners hold backgrounds in eco-tourism and outdoor leadership and describe themselves as passionate outdoor enthusiasts.

Washington. The contact page provides a phone number (250.871.8807) and email not present in OSM. The OSM address points to a single civic address that appears to be the management office rather than any one rental property.
